name: reflow-split-rivals
note: Issue #669 (pattern reflow-motion R1/R2/R4, split-panes R7 Windows): the Rivals split pane slides and fades in and out on the compositor, so UIA reads the final layout at once. Mid-motion the Close button is already named, a button and 40x40 epx, and the list reads before the pane; Close and Alt+Left return focus to the opening row while the leaving pane fades, then the pane leaves the tree. reflow_trace requires two opens and two closes, instant (no split-move, un-animated settles) in app-reduced and no-animations.

name: reflow-suggestions-resize
note: Issue #669 (pattern reflow-motion R1/R3/R4, wide-columns R4): narrowing to medium and widening back glides the Suggestions cards to their new columns on the compositor. The same cards stay loaded in reading order (one card per item, then paired again), the first card stays on screen and keyboard focus stays on its row although the rebuilt lines recycle its container (ReflowMotion.KeepFocus). reflow_trace requires both column changes, instant in app-reduced and no-animations.

name: reflow-shop-resize

name: reflow-large-text-resize
note: Issue #669 (pattern reflow-motion R3, wide-columns R1): at Windows' largest text size Suggestions keeps one column, so resizing reflows nothing; the cards stay loaded and in order.

name: reflow-statistics-resize
note: Issue #669 review (pattern reflow-motion R1/R4, wide-columns R4): narrowing Profile/Statistics to medium and widening back glides the instrument sections (LeaderboardsCardGridLayout) between two columns and one. Keyboard focus stays on the Lead Songs Played tile, the sections keep their Level 2 headings and read Lead then Bass in both layouts. reflow_trace requires both card-grid column changes, and in app-reduced and no-animations requires them instant (motion=0, moved=0, entered=0). Focus is asserted right after each resize: a UIA scroll that takes the focused tile out of view moves focus without any reflow, so the page focuses the tile again before widening.

name: reflow-statistics-large-text-resize
note: Issue #669 review (pattern reflow-motion R3, wide-columns R1): at Windows' largest text size Profile/Statistics keeps one column, so resizing reflows nothing; Bass stays under Lead, read after it, and keyboard focus stays on the Lead Songs Played tile.

name: reflow-stop-split-rivals
note: Issue #669 review (pattern reflow-motion R4): motion turned off while a split pane slides stops the move at once where it was heading. Moves are stretched to 3 s (FST_DEBUG_REFLOW_MS) so the switch lands mid-move: Windows Animation effects turn off while the pane opens (animations:off, restored by the matrix), and the app's Reduce Motion turns on while it closes (FST_DEBUG_MOTION_KEY's Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M flips the setting as Settings does). reflow_stops requires both settles stopped=1 well before the 3 s move ends; the opened pane keeps its named Close button and the close still returns focus to the row.

name: reflow-stop-statistics
note: Issue #669 review (pattern reflow-motion R4): motion turned off while the Profile/Statistics instrument sections glide between columns stops every glide and fade at once in its settled place. Moves are stretched to 3 s (FST_DEBUG_REFLOW_MS): Windows Animation effects turn off during the narrowing (animations:off, restored by the matrix) and the app's Reduce Motion turns on during the widening (FST_DEBUG_MOTION_KEY). reflow_stops requires a reflow-stop after each moving card-grid reflow; focus stays on the Lead Songs Played tile and the sections keep their order.
